out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Contents of Plan & Specifications Submission
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit properly prepared plans or specifications as required under Section 8-201.11. OBSERVED 2- DELFIELD HOT FOOD TABLES IN DINING AREA, DESSERT REFRIGERATED DISPLAY CASE AT CAFE, VEVOR SNOWMAKER AT BAR/CAFE, SODA MACHINE IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Based on the type of operation, type of food preparation, and foods prepared, the permit applicant/holder must submit the following documents: (A) Intended menu; (B) Anticipated volume of food to be stored, prepared, and sold or served; (C) Proposed layout, mechanical schematics, construction materials, and finish schedules; (D) Proposed equipment types, manufacturers, model numbers, locations, dimensions, performance capacities, and installation specifications; (E) Evidence that standard procedures that ensure compliance with the requirements of this Code are developed or are being developed; and (F) Other information that may be required by the Health Department for the proper review of the proposed construction, conversion or modification, and procedures for operating a food establishment. SUBMIT AMENDMENT IN PLUS FOR ADDITIONAL EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW BEEF STORED ON SHELF ABOVE MARINADES IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED MARINADES TO OTHER SHELF.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORTIONED RICE OBSERVED AT 125F IN HOT HOLDING CABINET SET AT 115.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM STATED RICE WAS TO BE DISCARDED. CFM DISCARDED RICE. EHS EDUCATED CFM THAT PORTIONED RICE MUST BE KEPT AT 135F OR HIGHER TO MAINTAIN PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: HOUSE-MADE KIMCHI WITH DATEMARK OF 4/19.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED CFM TO DISCARD KIMCHI. HOUSE MADE KIMCHI CAN ONLY BE KEPT FOR 7 DAYS (INCLUDING PREPARATION DATE).

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION WITH NO PROPER NAME IDENTIFIER.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE LABEL SPRAY BOTTLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: OBSERVED THINLY SLICED PORK BELLY STORED DIRECTLY INTO CHEST FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PORK BELLY MUST BE STORED IN FOOD SAFE CONTAINER AND PLACED INTO THE CHEST FREEZER. SANITIZE INTERIOR OF CHEST FREEZER.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIP OR IRREVERSIBLE REGISTERING THERMOMETER TO TEST SANITIZER TEMPERATURE OF HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: CFM WILL PURCHASE TEST STRIPS OR THERMOMETER AND SEND RECEIPT TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. PROVIDE EHS WITH RECEIPT WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED GREASE TRAP ODOR IN DISH WASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: CFM STATED THEY WERE GETTING QUOTES FOR GREASE TRAP CLEANING. PROVIDE EHS GREASE TRAP RECEIPT ONCE CLEANED.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: observed raw thinly beef stored directly in chest freezer - observed sheet pan on bottom of chest freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. EHS clarified that beef cannot be stored directly in chest freezer with food in direct contact with walls of equipment. Food must be stored in food-safe containers.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean between Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Equipment food contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned between working with raw foods and ready-to-eat foods. Observed employees using same pair of tongs to place cooked beef on serving platter and then pick another serving of raw beef from container onto grill.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned each time there is a change from working with raw foods to working with ready to eat foods. EHS educated employee and CFM to use separate tongs to portion and place raw beef from container and another to handle cooked beef. Do not use same pair of tongs to continually handle raw and fully cooked beef.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Observed the hot water sanitizing dish machine at a maximum temperature of 155F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS discussed with CFM converting dish machine to chemical sanitizing machine. CFM will contact dish machine repair ASAP and provide EHS with update. Dish machine may be used to wash and rinse dishes, and 3 compartment sink will be set up to sanitize all dishware.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed portioned rice in hot holding unit at 118F, 122F, and 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM stated rice was recently portioned and placed in unit. EHS educated CFM that cooked rice must maintain a temperature of at least 135F even during portioning and holding in unit, unless CFM would like to add portioned rice to TPHC agreement. CFM increased temperature of hot holding unit. KHAN K-BBQ (Inspection Date: 11/06/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: mandu, tteokboki, japchae, popcorn chicken were observed marked with end point of 5:00PM. Time food was to be in use was observed on placard at 11:00-5:00PM.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS had CFM update end time to 3:00PM.

violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: observed thinly sliced pork belly stored in cardboard box in chest freezer.

violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: observed raw sliced beef stored directly in chest freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CFM will move beef into food safe containers.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed thermolabel color unchanged after running through dish machine. EHS ran dish plate thermometer and observed a maximum temperature of 154F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS advised CFM that dish machine can be used for cleaning and rinsing and that all sanitizing must be done in 3 compartment sink with bleach sanitizer. CFM educated dish employees on proper procedure until dish machine is fixed. EHS will follow up in 10 days due to long weekend.
